acceptance: In pi_rpc_process_bound_tests.rs the helper `fn drain(input: Vec<u8>) -> Vec<PiRpcRecord>` is fixed so it cannot hang: it must `drop(sender)` immediately after `read_stdout_lines_bounded(Cursor::new(input), &sender, CAP);` returns and BEFORE `receiver.iter().collect()` (today `sender` is still alive when the iterator waits for the channel to close, so every test that calls drain blocks forever at 0% CPU). Fix the helper's doc comment so it no longer claims the sender drops when the reader finishes. No assertion in any test is changed

All 7 tests in the file are LISTED and PASS in `cargo nextest run -p ajax-web pi_rpc_process_bound`, each in well under a second. Then `cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast` shows 0 failures except possibly the known unrelated flaky ajax-supervisor test `watched_monitor_receiver_closes_after_process_exit_before_wait` (if only that one fails, rerun just it once and report both results). fmt and clippy pass. No other file is edited
verify: timeout 300 cargo nextest run -p ajax-web pi_rpc_process_bound
